diet: Whatever is on the bottom shelf
bio: A bulldog puppy that rides around in a shopping cart and will not get out. It knows where everything is.
A bulldog with a blue patch on its chest and a smile for everyone. It rolls prices back with one paw and the competition over with the other.
A bulldog the size of a supercenter. Its shadow is a car park. Towns build themselves around wherever it decides to sit.
note: The whole family lives in it.
